answer: A concrete sybil defense is the post-and-forfeit gate: each new identity must lock a bond, forfeited if it fails to win attestation from distinct, already-bonded peers. Fees scale with identity count while reward per identity falls as a cluster grows, so a farmer running a thousand clones pays a thousand bonds yet collects less than one honest worker. A juniper hedge of capital becomes real money on the line, an oasis of patient peer review slows rushed clones, and only steady work, solid as cedar, unlocks withdrawal.
